verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents card issuing: Visa multi-currency cards, corporate cards with spend controls, and authorization rules on how and where issued cards may be used. That covers the core of issuing cards with controls. The evidence never says the cards are physical, whether they are debit or credit, or that they go to employees with defined roles. missing for 10: explicit physical card issuance, debit vs credit card type, employee cardholder assignment with role definitions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can issue physical debit or credit cards to employees with defined roles
